strings.zh: 输给你了,不过{NEWLINE}这场对战我觉得很开心⋯⋯{SCROLL}在这边钓鱼的时候,{NEWLINE}偶尔能钓到{CLEAR}别人掉在水里的道具,{CLEAR}到时候送给你吧⋯⋯{SCROLL}把你的电话号码{NEWLINE}告诉我怎样？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I lost to you, but I really enjoyed that{NEWLINE}battle...{SCROLL}When I fish here, I sometimes hook items{NEWLINE}people dropped in the water.{SCROLL}When I do, I’ll give them to you...{NEWLINE}How about telling me{CLEAR}your phone number? {VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0676/1 | RV072: omission: restored the loss; layout rebalance 2026-10-09 (prompt icons / single-word page)

strings.zh: 钓到好东西后{NEWLINE}我会联系给你的！
strings.en: If I snag anything good, I’ll be sure to{NEWLINE}let you know.

strings.zh: 是妈⋯⋯{NEWLINE}那等你改变主意了再来吧。
strings.en: All right... Come back if you have a{NEWLINE}change of heart.

strings.zh: 我钓到东西的话会给你的！{SCROLL}要登录我的{NEWLINE}电话号码吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: If I snag an item while I’m fishing,{NEWLINE}it’s yours. Trade me numbers? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 你来了啊,{SCROLL}看！{NEWLINE}我钓到了这种精灵球！{SCROLL}不过上面粘有水草,{NEWLINE}所以看不清是什么球,{CLEAR}你应该能看出来吧？{SCROLL}
strings.en: There you are! Look! I fished up this{NEWLINE}Poké Ball!{SCROLL}But it’s covered in water weeds, so I{NEWLINE}can’t tell what kind of Ball it is.{SCROLL}You should be able to tell, right?{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0676/5 | RV072: meaning: matched zh opening and question

strings.zh: 切！{NEWLINE}被蚊香蝌蚪给逃了！{SCROLL}别打电话给我,{NEWLINE}直接到我身边来{CLEAR}和我聊天！
strings.en: Tch! The Poliwag got away!{SCROLL}Don’t call me. Come over{NEWLINE}and talk to me in person!

strings.zh: 我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}已经成长得很强了！{CLEAR}垂钓的技术也有长进了！{SCROLL}前段时间我刚把{VAR:0100:11}{NEWLINE}给打败了⋯⋯{SCROLL}不过比起战斗的胜利{NEWLINE}我更享受垂钓的乐趣。{SCROLL}下次再聊吧。
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10}’s grown impressive!{NEWLINE}My fishing skills have improved, too!{SCROLL}We beat a wild {VAR:0100:11}...{NEWLINE}You know, I have more fun fishing{CLEAR}than beating wild Pokémon.{SCROLL}All right, later.

strings.zh: 我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}已经成长得很强了！{CLEAR}垂钓的技术也有长进了！{SCROLL}不过,前段时间{NEWLINE}就差最后一下下的时候{CLEAR}还是被{VAR:0100:11}给逃掉了⋯⋯{SCROLL}还是那么大的！{SCROLL}算了,再见。
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10}’s grown impressive!{NEWLINE}My fishing skills have improved, too!{SCROLL}But some time ago, we came this close{NEWLINE}to landing a wild {VAR:0100:11}.{CLEAR}I tell you, it was huge. Believe me.{SCROLL}All right, later.

strings.zh: 我现在在{VAR:0104:3}{NEWLINE}钓鱼,{CLEAR}不过什么也没钓上来⋯⋯{SCROLL}怎么样？{NEWLINE}再来一场对战吧？{CLEAR}虽然我现在也并不是{CLEAR}太闲。
strings.en: I’m fishing at {VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}but I haven’t caught a thing...{SCROLL}How about it? Want to battle again? Not{NEWLINE}that I’ve got all that much free time.

strings.zh: {VAR:0104:3}最近{NEWLINE}都钓不到什么大家伙了⋯⋯{SCROLL}快来和我对战吧。
strings.en: I haven’t hooked anything big on{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3} lately...{SCROLL}Hurry and come battle me.
strings.notes: US 0676/10 | RV072: meaning: no big catches; request to battle

strings.zh: 嗯,最近没钓到{NEWLINE}什么好东西,{SCROLL}你耐心点等着吧。
strings.en: Nah, I haven’t found anything that’s{NEWLINE}worth your time.{SCROLL}You have to have patience.

strings.zh: 哦哦,刚才{NEWLINE}好像有什么道具上钩了！{SCROLL}我想你会用得上的,{NEWLINE}快来{VAR:0104:3}吧！
strings.en: Ooh, looks like some item just got{NEWLINE}hooked!{SCROLL}I think you’ll find it useful, so hurry{NEWLINE}to {VAR:0104:3}!
strings.notes: US 0676/12 | RV072: omission: restored 'you'll find it useful'

strings.zh: 你不来拿道具吗？{NEWLINE}什么？不知道我在哪？{SCROLL}我就在{VAR:0104:3}啊,{NEWLINE}从卡吉镇往烟墨市那边走{CLEAR}你就能看到了！
strings.en: Don’t you want this item? Huh? You{NEWLINE}don’t know where I am?{SCROLL}I’m on {VAR:0104:3}!{SCROLL}Head from Mahogany Town toward{NEWLINE}Blackthorn City, and you’ll see me!
strings.notes: US 0676/13 | RV072: omission: restored 'you'll see me'
